synthesis.design: Fuse (i)+(ii); ALL logic in the non-canonical profile-opus-4-7.py, workflow only passes flags. Add a 6th corpus entry ref_exec sampled ROUND-ROBIN inside each entry's loop (fixes the S318 decorrelation all 3 critics named: entry 1 read 45-70ms while a later entry hit 159-698ms in the SAME run). Two keys per entry: absolute (unchanged) + runner-normalized relative. Candidate (ii) standalone is REJECTED (slow-day amnesty = detection zero exactly when the runner is bad); only its label vocabulary survives. Ship PHASE 1 advisory-only: labels computed and published, exit codes byte-identical to today; K pinned later by a second ceremony.
synthesis.gate_rule: Per entry: abs_ok = hook_p95 <= 180 (unchanged). rel_ok = hook_p50 <= K_e * ref_p50 — p50 on BOTH sides (ADR-163:258 median doctrine; measured runner p95/p50 spread 1.05/1.04/2.25 makes any p95-over-p50 ratio swing 2x on unregressed code). abs_ok && rel_ok => pass exit 0. !abs_ok && rel_ok && p95<=600 => advisory_slow_runner exit 0 + ::warning:: + summary row. !abs_ok && (!rel_ok || p95>600) => real_regression exit 1. ref_p50 non-finite/<=0/bool/str, ref split-half p50 drift >1.5x, or self-elapsed >0.9*wall-budget => infrastructure_contended exit 5 (the self-cap fires BEFORE timeout 420, so rc124 stays unreachable). Phase 1: label published, exit code = today's.
synthesis.reference_measure: Frozen 3-term stdlib-ONLY subprocess, source pinned by sha256 in the report: (1) import json/re/hashlib/pathlib + a fixed re.compile set, (2) fixed CPU hash loop, (3) M x open/append/flock/fsync/rename under entry_tmp/ref, same FS as the audit dir. MUST NOT import _lib or .claude/hooks — unanimous: the WS-J class this gate exists for IS an eager _lib import, which inflates numerator AND denominator and blinds the ratio to its own reason to exist. The IO term is mandatory: a 7.76ms spawn floor beside a 361ms hook is a disk/page-cache signature, and a CPU-only ref stays as blind as the spawn probe. n_ref>=40, p50 via _pct_of_sorted. Scrub CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR_NATIVE in the per-entry env (highest-precedence carrier, currently unscrubbed — S321/S326 class).
synthesis.threshold_derivation: K is NOT derivable today: zero paired (hook, ref) samples exist anywhere, local or CI (unanimous; each critic's own local numbers are self-declared contaminated). Ship the PROCEDURE. Phase 1 (--exec-reference --relative-advisory) publishes R_e = hook_p50/ref_p50 per entry; after >=10 green CI runs over >=3 days, K_e = 1.25 * max(R_e). ADMISSIBILITY, which is what answers the criterion: K_e <= (baseline_p50_e + 150)/max(ref_p50), so the +150ms plant still fails at the WORST observed reference. An EMPTY interval means the reference is mis-shaped and the design is REJECTED — never widen K, that is the 'bump the number' move already failed at ADR-163:291. Expected 2-4; any K written into a package before that window is invented.
synthesis.positive_control: Hermetic per-PR in .claude/scripts/tests/: mock the timing source so check_output_secrets yields baseline+150ms while ref_exec stays at baseline; assert label=='real_regression' AND exit 1 — predicate-level, never wall-clock luck. Live (workflow_dispatch): extend PLAN-159/wave2-regression-proof.sh, which already plants time.sleep(0.15) in a throwaway worktree and requires the JOB red through the real wrapper, with (a) assert label=='real_regression', not merely exit!=0; (b) ref_p50 delta clean-vs-planted <15%, proving the plant hit the HOOK not the machine; (c) a SECOND plant of eager module-scope imports — sleep is IO wait and misses the WS-J shape; (d) re-run the plant WITH the negative-control load and still require real_regression. Fooled by: a plant in a term the ref shares; K admitted from the fast band only; a hook slow only on Linux (run it in CI too).
synthesis.negative_control: Clean clone, unregressed, same machine, 3 arms because the CPU-vs-IO cause is unsettled on disk. N1 CPU: nproc busy-loop siblings (taskset -c 0 on Linux; absent on macOS; nice alone reorders and creates NO contention, so it is not a stressor). N2 IO: dd conv=fsync loop on entry_tmp's device, matching the field signature. N3 ref-starvation trap: starve ONLY the reference (slow FS for entry_tmp/ref) and require infrastructure_contended, never pass. Assert BOTH label in {advisory_slow_runner, infrastructure_contended} (never real_regression) AND R_loaded/R_quiet in [0.7,1.4] — the ratio half is the anti-vacuity check: a CPU burner against an IO-bound hook starves the REFERENCE harder, the ratio FALLS, and the control passes for the wrong reason. Declared residual: an IO-slow runner is indistinguishable from an IO regression by any ref that also does IO.

synthesis.adr163_amendment_outline: ## Amendment (PLAN-169 S328) — runner-normalized second key; the spawn probe is blind by construction. CONTEXT: Validate failed a16ac96 (run 32866209415) with check_output_secrets p95 361.4/424.8/229.1ms vs the 180ms hard ceiling while the spawn probe read UNCONTENDED 7.76ms and the same SHA ran 70-77ms locally; 56f050c 209->435ms; 6304f66 PASSED the same morning — and git diff 6304f66..a16ac96 touches ZERO files under .claude/hooks/, so identical hook bytes gave PASS and FAIL 3.5h apart. `python3 -c pass` prices the spawn floor, a few percent of a hook importing ~16.5k lines of _lib plus a locked write. DECISION: keep 180ms hard (no third recalibration after :291's 120->180); add hook_p50 <= K_e*ref_p50 against a frozen stdlib-only 3-term execution reference sampled round-robin; four named outcomes; phase 1 advisory until >=10 green runs pin K_e by the admissibility bound. Spawn probe kept, vestigial.

test_plan: Extract a PURE classify_entry(hook_p50, hook_p95, ref_p50, ceiling, K_e) -> (label, passed); today timing lives inside the subprocess loop, so with subprocess.run mocked every sample is ~0 and the existing test can only fake a breach with an impossible ceiling of -1.

Full 2x2 truth table in .claude/scripts/tests/test_hook_latency_relative_gate.py asserting label AND exit code (0/1/5) per cell. The design in one test: the SAME hook numbers (p50 250 / p95 361) give advisory_slow_runner with ref_p50 210 and real_regression with ref_p50 60.

Adversarial ref_p50 -> infrastructure_contended, never pass: 0 (no ZeroDivisionError), -1, NaN, -Infinity, True (bool), '-1' (str), missing key. Reuse the exact case list already proven for contention_probe (codex r1 F8) so the two parsers cannot diverge. Plus split-half drift >1.5x.

ANTI-COUPLING: AST-walk the frozen reference source, assert it imports nothing under _lib or .claude/hooks, and assert its sha256 matches the value in the report (a future edit making the ref heavier silently loosens the gate). Positive control: a planted `from _lib import audit_emit` must turn this test RED.

Precondition parity: n_ref < 22 -> a named reference_indices_collapsed error with passed=False, fired BEFORE any subprocess spawn, mirroring ADR-163:258's percentile_indices_collapsed contract. Label set derived from a module-level OUTCOMES tuple asserted to have exactly 4 members (closed sets are derived, never recalled).

Interleaving invariant: mock subprocess.run with a call-index recorder and assert ref samples are spread (max gap <= 2k), blocking a future optimisation back into one pre-loop block — the S318 probe bug re-created.

BACK-COMPAT: without --exec-reference the JSON keys and exit codes are byte-identical to today; --floor JSON still carries subprocess_floor_ms.p50 (proof-retry-matrix.sh parses it); the observe positive control still sees on_rows == iterations (ref writes only under entry_tmp/ref). disagreements: n_ref: A demands >=60, B 40, C 25. ADOPTED 40 — A's >=22 index-separation argument applies to p95, and the relative key is gated on p50, where index collapse does not arise. Costs ~3% of the wall cap.

K formula: A = 1.6 x median(ratio) reusing ADR-163's declared detection factor; B = 1.25 x max(ratio) PLUS an admissibility bound; C = m x r0 with m 2.5->2.0. ADOPTED B — it is the only one that mechanically proves the +150ms positive control still fails at the WORST observed reference, which is the decision criterion. A's 1.6x is kept as a sanity floor on the resulting K.

abs_ok && !rel_ok => real_regression (new power closing ADR-163:291's declared blind spot): B and C want it ON, A wants the <=180 short-circuit so the verdict stays bit-identical. NOT decided here — product judgment, see open questions. Default OFF; the cell is implemented and unit-tested behind a flag.

rc124 relabel at validate.yml:1372 (a 420s cap-kill stamped 'real regression'): B wants +8 canonical lines, A wants zero. ADOPTED zero — the profiler self-caps at 0.9 x wall-budget and exits 5 first, making rc124 unreachable in practice. The pre-existing mislabel is RECORDED in the ADR as a known defect, not fixed here (it would grow the canonical diff for a case the self-cap removes).

Candidate (ii) standalone: B rates ADOPT_WITH_CHANGES, A and C REJECT. ADOPTED REJECT — B itself concedes it is safe 'only if the advisory state still applies a RELATIVE key hard', which collapses it into (i). Its label vocabulary is kept in full.
Deleting the spawn probe: A says leave it vestigial (smaller canonical diff), B/C imply replacing it. ADOPTED A — removal buys nothing and grows the diff.
open_questions_for_owner: Enable the abs_ok && !rel_ok => real_regression cell? It closes the blind spot ADR-163:291 itself declares (a clean 2x regression on the fastest entry stays invisible under 180ms) but can mint reds on unregressed code while K is young. Proposed default OFF in phase 1. This is a detection-floor product call.

The 600ms absolute backstop (above which a slow runner still FAILs instead of going advisory) has no evidence behind it — it is a 'what latency is unusable in a real session' judgment. Name it, or authorize deriving it from the phase-1 distribution.

Accept a phase-1 window of >=10 CI runs / >=3 days in which NO relative key gates (detection stays exactly today's, including the current false-red exposure)? The alternative is shipping an invented K, which all three critics reject.

If the admissibility interval comes back EMPTY (1.25 x maxR > (base+150)/max_ref), the reference is mis-shaped and the fallback is a LARGER canonical change — pinning the runner image, pre-warming the import set, or shipping .pyc. Authorize that branch in advance or require a return to the Owner.
